subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should plain Telegram group last-route persistence be fixed inside the Telegram plugin, or should maintainers wait for a shared non-direct session fallback to own this behavior across channels?
rationale: Both boundaries are plausible: the source gap is Telegram-specific today, but the related open PR proposes a broader session-layer fallback with compatibility risk and no proof for this issue yet.

options.title: Fix Telegram plain groups now
options.body: Add explicit Telegram plain-group last-route persistence while preserving the existing DM pin and bound-topic behavior, then require live Telegram restart proof.

options.title: Adopt the shared fallback
options.body: Use the broader session-layer fallback only after conflicts are resolved and it proves plain Telegram group persistence as well as the Mattermost case.

options.title: Hold for owner design
options.body: Keep the issue open until a channel/session owner decides whether plain group route persistence is channel-owned or core-owned.

recommendation.title: Fix Telegram plain groups now
recommendation.body: Add explicit Telegram plain-group last-route persistence while preserving the existing DM pin and bound-topic behavior, then require live Telegram restart proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main blame and release ownership put this person closest to both touched surfaces, though Telegram/forum-topic history is shared.
